title: Home Comfort Financing Payoff — Payment-Record Relief After a Promotion
content:
The payoff payment-record relief on a Home Comfort Financing account applies only when the plan's promotion has ended: it is 10 percent when the payments posted less than 12 whole months before the day of payoff, less the returned payments posted in that time, number at least 12, 5 percent when that count is at least 6 but below 12, and zero when the count is lower or the promotion has not ended.

*The promotion has ended* when the plan has a promotional period and its promotional end date is before the day of payoff. A fixed-rate plan has no promotional period, so its promotion never ends in this sense.

## Truth table

| Promotion ended before the day of payoff | Payments less returned payments, last 12 whole months | Payoff payment-record relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 10 percent |
| yes | 6 to 11 | 5 percent |
| yes | 5 or fewer | zero |
| no (including every fixed-rate plan) | any | zero |

The relief is one of the payoff reliefs, which are added together into the payoff relief percentage; the starting rate is reduced once by that total and the reliefs never act one after another.

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- An 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment account paid off two months after its promotional end date, with 14 payments and 1 returned payment in the last 12 whole months: count 13, relief 10 percent.
- The same account paid off one day before its promotional end date: the promotion has not ended, relief zero.
- A 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate account with 12 payments and no returns: zero, since the plan has no promotion to end.
